# SequenceAwareSpikingDetection

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An object detection framework that leverages temporal sequences of spike events from event cameras to improve detection accuracy by encoding motion and context over time. Enables neuromorphic vision systems to process dynamic scenes more effectively, aligning with iNEST's goal of bio-inspired, event-driven computation.
